system.effect:
Once per heist, the ST may make one of your rolls Difficulty 4 (or +1, if it was already 4 or more), because you chose the flashier approach; Alert penalties still apply on top. It pays your Flaw Moment if it costs you — or if you Critical anyway; the crowd appreciated it. Spend 1 SP to delay the trigger one round.

You'll take the flashier, harder approach. Sometimes it even works.
